given: subject A maps only to synthetic UID A; subject B maps only to synthetic UID B
when: A supplies B-like headers, resource IDs, socket hints, and cursors
then: gateway ignores browser routing hints
every A request reaches only A's configured socket
B snapshot and SSE bytes are absent
unknown or duplicate mapping returns identity_mapping_denied

given: daemon socket belongs to user A
when: a peer other than the configured gateway UID connects
then: daemon returns peer_not_authorized without reading native state
a mapping/socket mismatch never falls back to another daemon

given: snapshot watermark is sequence 41
when: native changes occur during snapshot serialization and the client opens events after cursor 41
then: snapshot is an atomic view at 41
the stream starts at 42
no change is lost or applied twice

given: client last applied sequence 42
when: event 42 is replayed then 43 arrives
then: 42 is ignored by event_id/cursor
43 applies once
an out-of-order sequence greater than one marks writes disabled and starts resnapshot

given: requested cursor is older than oldest_replay_cursor or names another server instance
when: events endpoint is opened
then: HTTP 409 cursor_expired or cursor_instance_mismatch is returned before SSE starts
client disables writes and atomically replaces state with a fresh snapshot

given: one SSE client cannot keep up with native output
when: the implementation's measured resource or delivery limit is reached
then: that connection closes without stopping Pi or silently losing the current state
reconnect uses replay where available or a fresh snapshot
large native content remains readable through content pagination under the current wire limits

given: an accepted command remains in the same ledger epoch
when: the identical body and client_command_id are submitted again
then: the original result is returned and execution is not repeated
the same ID with another body returns command_id_conflict

given: the connection ends before acceptance response
when: client fetches a fresh snapshot and command status
then: a matching retained result reconciles it
absence never proves non-delivery after ledger epoch change or eviction
there is no automatic resend
a deliberate resend uses a new ID and explicit confirmation

given: a daemon-owned RPC turn is running
when: tab and SSE close
then: Pi child continues
later cursor replay or snapshot shows native progress
browser connection is never process owner

given: a daemon-owned RPC turn is running
when: daemon crashes and systemd performs service-level child cleanup
then: native completed history remains
new epoch makes unresolved commands uncertain
an ended browser conversation can be deliberately continued once its previous work is known to have ended; unresolved work cannot gain another writer

given: history is readable and a terminal TUI is observed live
when: browser opens the terminal history or attempts to control it
then: history remains readable without starting a writer
terminal control and takeover are unavailable
daemon does not signal a terminal process

given: owned Pi 0.85.1 RPC advertises verified capabilities
when: message, steer, follow_up, clear_queue or interrupt is sent
then: adapter maps only verified Pi operations
clear_queue clears the whole queue
interruption is best effort and does not claim detached native tools stopped
unsupported or unknown capability returns capability_unsupported or capability_unknown

given: history contains raw HTML, javascript URLs, malformed Markdown/diff, unknown event and control characters
when: snapshot, query, and SSE are decoded
then: schema-invalid envelopes are rejected
valid unknown native payload is escaped generic text
no supplied HTML or URL executes
malformed renderer input retains a plain-text fallback

given: title adapter capability is verified supported and an earlier successful title exists
when: daemon-owned one-off Pi model call fails then a user requests regeneration with a new command ID
then: failure preserves prior title and conversation progress
pending/succeeded/failed are observable
success atomically replaces only title annotation
browser never performs the model call

given: one-off Pi model-call adapter has not been verified
when: snapshot is read or title command is attempted
then: capability is unknown with adapter_not_verified
command fails capability_unknown
display remains Uusi keskustelu or daemon-derived first-message fallback

given: target is a symlink, is replaced after preflight, contains descendant symlinks, or escapes the opened src descriptor
when: create, clone, settings, or delete is requested
then: descriptor-relative no-follow resolution rejects it
outside sentinel is unchanged
error names path_unsupported, path_replaced, or path_escape without disclosing another user's path

given: managed process stop succeeds and manual linked worktree blocks deletion
when: deletion proceeds
then: confirmed stop remains confirmed
workspace removal is skipped
fresh source observation reports directory present
retry requires a new observation token and never claims rollback

given: remote repository creation succeeds but origin setup or plain git push fails
when: operation settles
then: remote creation remains a confirmed effect
failure stage and local Git state remain visible
retry starts only after fresh Git/GitHub/transport observation
no credential is returned to browser

given: one worktree is Taskfleet-owned and another is manual or ownership is unknown
when: teardown or deletion is requested
then: owned teardown uses Taskfleet's exact run identity
manual/unknown worktree is read-only and blocks destructive cleanup
branch display fragment is never treated as ownership

given: user state annotation is missing, invalid, truncated, or has unknown version
when: snapshot is built
then: Pi history, Git, filesystem and Taskfleet facts remain available
only hidden/archive/title/annotated-parent presentation is lost or unknown
source warning is emitted and corrupt bytes are not silently overwritten

given: controlled process is settled and pi history is readable
when: archive then unarchive/resume commands complete
then: archive changes only annotation
resume uses the same pi session ID
no transcript copy or new platform conversation is created

given: the target native resource has changed since the browser observation
when: the browser submits a command with the stale target observation token
then: host returns stale_precondition with fresh_snapshot_required
no mutation starts from the stale target observation
unrelated streamed output alone does not invalidate a command

given: an authenticated cookie exists
when: a write has missing/wrong Origin or missing/wrong session-bound CSRF header
then: gateway returns origin_denied or csrf_denied before daemon routing
no command ledger entry or native effect exists

given: delete preflight returns workspace name and observation token
when: confirmation differs by any code point or token no longer matches filesystem identity
then: confirmation_mismatch or stale_precondition is retained as a rejected command
no process, worktree, or directory mutation starts

given: a session has an open SSE connection
when: logout, idle expiry, absolute expiry, or gateway session restart invalidates it
then: gateway closes that session's SSE connections
reconnect returns authentication_required or session_expired
daemon-owned Pi work continues

given: request declares an unsupported schema version or extra forbidden field
when: gateway/daemon validates it
then: schema_version_unsupported or invalid_request is returned
nothing is entered in the ledger or executed

given: URL after is 41 but client last applied SSE id is cursor 57
when: EventSource reconnects with Last-Event-ID 57
then: server prefers 57 and begins at 58
sequences at or below client last-applied are duplicate replays
only a sequence above last+1 causes a gap

given: an authenticated user's src listing is empty and snapshot supplies user_observation_token
when: workspace.create or workspace.github.clone uses target.scope user and that token
then: daemon binds the token to web identity and opened src descriptor
a changed/missing/replaced src root yields stale_precondition
the first workspace can be created without inventing an existing resource ID

given: a terminal operation result is available in the current daemon epoch
when: the browser reloads or deep-links to its operation ID
then: query returns the staged terminal result with ledger epoch and expiry
eviction or daemon restart returns operation_outcome_unknown
absence never means success

given: steering and follow-up items race with delivery while clear is accepted
when: agent.queue.clear succeeds
then: result contains only actually removed texts with source groups and original indexes
post-clear queue revision is returned
stale failed or uncertain results contain no removed queue

given: a fresh GitHub create capability carries an exact_repository owner/repository challenge
when: confirmation differs by any byte or its observation token is stale
then: confirmation_mismatch or stale_precondition is returned
no GitHub or Git mutation starts

given: a freshly reauthenticated mapped user has connected native GitHub state
when: identity.github.disconnect targets user scope with a fresh user observation token
then: the daemon removes local GitHub CLI authentication without claiming server-side revocation
success is reported only after local auth absence is observed
partial cleanup remains partial and web logout alone preserves native GitHub state

given: browser session is broker-mapped to synthetic UID A and Pi OAuth is absent or unavailable
when: direct snapshot/history/content URLs are requested after sign-in and after native status changes
then: daemon verifies peer and mapped identity before querying Pi
native reads do not run unless a fresh Pi OAuth status is usable
status returns only missing, usable or unknown and no credential bytes
a different identity or an unavailable daemon never exposes native names

given: a browser-owned Pi session emits a valid queue_update frame
when: daemon receives the frame while events are being replayed
then: a queue.changed frame has the Pi agent resource, revision and steering/follow_up arrays
the event cursor follows earlier frames and reconnect replays exactly the retained frame
an expired cursor requires a new snapshot; queue event alone is not a command receipt
